cut_denominator_lemma.proof: Encode norm 2/4 by a vertex bit. The crystallographic m3 equation forces equal bits and the m4 equation forces unequal bits, hence m4=delta(X); the converse Gram formula is integral.
cut_denominator_lemma.statement: For a connected support graph with m3 edges joining equal norms and m4 edges joining norm ratio 2, a primitive {2,4} normalization exists iff the m4 set is a cut delta(X). The two choices X and X^c are exactly the scaled-dual orientations.

theorem: The surface-free D34-cut denominator has 37180 raw labelings and 3610 support-automorphism orbits. Exactly 4789 labelings/374 orbits admit primitive {2,4} norms. Among all 748 scaled-dual integral Grams, exactly one diagram on S16 and one on S17 have rank/inertia (10;1,9,4). Their 28 stable even overclosures force one minimal weak K3 package each, and a fresh exact cone/Vinberg replay proves that both diagrams define finite-volume noncompact H9 Coxeter polytopes.
